ordered_diagnoses: Brain abscess due to bacterial infection

s1.syndrome_frame: Sepsis with acute neurological deterioration and multi-organ involvement
salient_findings: Fever and chills for two weeks
Sudden onset of confusion and unresponsiveness
Right pneumothorax with consolidation and atelectasis of the right lung
Enormous mixed-density lesions in the liver with fluid gas levels
Infarction with multiple gas accumulations in the brain
key_facts: 54-year-old female with non-insulin-dependent diabetes
Presented with fever and chills for two weeks
Developed sudden confusion and unresponsiveness for half an hour
Fell while walking on the day of admission
Dull mental state and slurred speech
Equal-sized bilateral pupils with sensitive light reflex
Absent breath sounds in right lung
Heart rate: 112 beats per minute
Initial blood pressure: 96/65 mmHg
C-reactive protein: 197.02 mg/L
Procalcitonin: 10.60 ng/mL
White blood cell count: 22.88 × 10^9/L
Neutrophil ratio: 94.6%
Lactate: 6.01 mmol/L
Venous blood glucose: 43.79 mmol/L
Arterial blood gases: pH 7.22, PCO2: 8 mmHg, PaO2: 77 mmHg, HCO3-: 11.6 mmol/L
Right pneumothorax with consolidation and atelectasis of the right lung on Chest CT
Enormous mixed-density lesions in the liver with fluid gas levels on Abdominal CT
Infarction with multiple gas accumulations in the brain on Follow-up Head CT
Blood culture positive for Klebsiella pneumoniae
Liver puncture fluid culture positive for Klebsiella pneumoniae
Pleural drainage culture positive for Klebsiella pneumoniae
